sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State of U.P. and gone through the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. read with Section 528 Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "BNSS") has been filed filed for the following main prayer:-
"

The petitioner named above most respectfully begs to submit that for the facts,
reasons and circumstances stated in the accompanying affidavit, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to quash the entire proceedings of S.T. No. (C.T.) 149/2019 'State Vs Sarabjeet @ Guddu', pending before the Learned Additional District &
Sessions Judge / Special Judge, POCSO Act, Court No.44, Barabanki, as well as Chargesheet No. A-207/2019, dated 07.07.2019, under section 363, 366, 376 I.P.C., &
Section 3/4 Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Jaidpur, District Barabanki, and Summoning order dated 03.09.2019, arising out of Case Crime No. 0208/2019, under sections-363 I.P.C., relating to Police Station - Jaidpur, District - Barabanki.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
It is further prayed that this Hon'ble High Court may kindly be pleased to stay the entire proceedings of S.T. No. (C.T.) 149/2019 'State Vs Sarabjeet @ Guddu', pending before the Learned Additional District & Sessions Judge / Special Judge, POCSO Act,
Court No.44, Barabanki, in the above mentioned case, in the interest of justice."
It is stated that applicant and opposite party No.2/victim were in affair and the victim at relevant point of time, as per school records, was more than 17 years of age, which is evident from Annexure No. 10 to the present application, as such, she was mature enough and victim on her own volition accompanied with the applicant and solemnized the marriage and out of this wedlock there is a male child and presently entire family is living happily under one roof.

entities.text:
Additional District & Sessions Judge / Special Judge, POCSO Act,
Court No.44, Barabanki
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is further stated that as per statement before the court concerned in terms of Section 164 Cr.P.C.
father of the victim was in fact torturing the victim and applicant.

It is also submitted that taking note of peculiar facts and circumstances of the case, indulgence of this Court is required else matrimonial life of applicant and opposite party No.2/victim would be ruined and development and future prospects of minor would also be affected rather ruined.
At this stage, on being asked, the opposite party No.2/victim before this Court stated that since marriage she is living happily with the applicant and she does not want to continue the case.

Considering the aforesaid as also the submissions made by learned Counsel for the parties as also the observations made by Apex Court in the case of Romgopal and others Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh, 2022 (1) SCJ 536, Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab [2012 10 SCC 303], Mohd. Ibrahim Vs.
State of U.P., 2022 SCC Online ALL 106, Gold Quest International Ltd. Vs. State of Tamilnadu, 2014 (15) SCC 235, B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, 2003 (4) SCC 675, Jitendra Raghuvanshi Vs. Babita Raghuvanshi, 2013(4) SCC 58, Madhavarao Jiwajirao Scindia Vs. Sambhajirao Chandrojirao Angre,
Sarabjeet @ Guddu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21922605/
2 1988 1 SCC 692, Nikhil Merchant Vs. C.B.I. and another, 2008(9) SCC 677, Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others, 2008(16) SCC 1, State of M.P. Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, 2019(5) SCC 688,
Narindra Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab and another, (2014) 6 SCC 466, Manoj Kumar and others Vs. State of U.P and others (2008) 8 SCC 781, Union Carbide Corporation and others Vs.
Union of India and others (1991) 4 SCC 584, Manohar Lal Sharma Vs. Principal Secretary and others (2014) 2 SCC 532 and Supreme Court Bar Association Vs. Union of India (1998) 4 SCC 409,
this Court is of the view that the present application is liable to be allowed as if this Court declines to interfere in the matter then in that eventuality the entire family would be shattered and minor's future would be ruined as also that in instant case the chances of ultimate conviction are extremely bleak and hence no useful purpose would be served by allowing the criminal proceedings to continue.

Consequently, the entire proceedings arising out of S.T. No. (C.T.) 149/2019, indicated in the prayer, quoted above, are hereby quashed.
Office/Registry is directed to send the copy of this order to the court concerned through email/fax for necessary compliance.
